dialogues.jp:
眠りが浅かったのかもしれない。恐らく、その
瞬間には目が覚めていた。
dialogues.en:
I can hear the sounds of her gentle footsteps. And I can
feel her temperature getting closer to me.
dialogues.text:
I can hear the sounds of her gentle footsteps. And I can
feel her temperature getting closer to me.

dialogues.jp:
ドアが開く音、空気の動く気配、そして、俺に
向けられている視線と感情……。
dialogues.en:
She stands next to my bed. I try to concentrate and breathe
normally.
dialogues.text:
She stands next to my bed. I try to concentrate and breathe
normally.

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、そっと入ってきたはずだ。それでも俺
は目が覚めてしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
I know she's looking at me like it hurts. I'm so nervous and
it makes my body stiff, but I try to relax my body to
pretend I was sleeping.
dialogues.text:
I know she's looking at me like it hurts. I'm so nervous and
it makes my body stiff, but I try to relax my body to
pretend I was sleeping.

dialogues.jp: 今、部屋の中に頼子さんが居る。
dialogues.en: The tick-tock of the alarm clock sounds loud to my ears.
dialogues.text: The tick-tock of the alarm clock sounds loud to my ears.

dialogues.jp:
かすかな足音。その体温が、近づいてきている
のが分かる。
dialogues.en:
The morning light is on my face and my blurry vision is in
orange.
dialogues.text:
The morning light is on my face and my blurry vision is in
orange.

dialogues.jp:
傍らに立った。俺は、規則正しい呼吸に意識を
集中した。
dialogues.en: How long do I have till the alarm goes off......?
dialogues.text: How long do I have till the alarm goes off......?

dialogues.jp:
視線が注がれているのが分かる。痛いほどに。
緊張に固まりそうになる身体を、強いて｛しかん／弛緩｝さ
せる。
dialogues.en: Then... the still air suddenly moves.
dialogues.text: Then... the still air suddenly moves.

dialogues.jp: ちくたくと、時計の進む音がやけに耳につく。
dialogues.en:
As a nice scent greets my nose, I feel a soft and warm touch
on my lips.
dialogues.text:
As a nice scent greets my nose, I feel a soft and warm touch
on my lips.

dialogues.jp:
朝の光が顔にかかっていて、視界はオレンジに
染まっていた。
目覚ましが鳴るまでに、あと何分あるだろう？
dialogues.en: I've felt this touch twice... no, maybe three times before.
dialogues.text: I've felt this touch twice... no, maybe three times before.

dialogues.jp:
と──しばらく固まっていた空気が、不意に動
いた。
dialogues.en: I guess I really was kissed once when I was sleeping.
dialogues.text: I guess I really was kissed once when I was sleeping.

dialogues.jp:
鼻先をいい匂いがかすめた、そう思う間もなく、
唇を、柔らかで温かな感触が走り抜けた。

dialogues.en:
If I suddenly get up right now, I might be able to press not
only my lips against hers but also my body against her body.
dialogues.text:
If I suddenly get up right now, I might be able to press not
only my lips against hers but also my body against her body.

dialogues.jp:
その感触を知るのは、２度目──いや、３度目
かもしれない。
dialogues.en: But I hesitate to do it.
dialogues.text: But I hesitate to do it.

dialogues.jp:
最初、やはり眠っている時にキスをされたこと
があったのかも。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure if it would turn out to be a sexual
assault......
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure if it would turn out to be a sexual
assault......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん……起きて下さい……」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san...... Please wake up......"
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san...... Please wake up......"

dialogues.jp:
優しい声とともに身体が揺すぶられて、俺は目
を開けた。
dialogues.en:
As she gently shakes my body with her gentle voice, I slowly
open my eyes.
dialogues.text:
As she gently shakes my body with her gentle voice, I slowly
open my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 赤い目が、優しげに俺を見つめていた。
dialogues.en: Her red eyes are gently looking at me.
dialogues.text: Her red eyes are gently looking at me.

dialogues.jp: たぶん、お互いにそんな目をしているのだろう。
dialogues.en: Most likely mine are as red as hers.
dialogues.text: Most likely mine are as red as hers.

dialogues.jp:
居間に入った途端、カレーの香ばしい匂いが漂っ
てきた。やっぱりというか。
dialogues.en: As I step into the living room, I smell curry.
dialogues.text: As I step into the living room, I smell curry.

dialogues.jp:
朝だけではなく、昼も夜もカレーで済ませられ
るくらい、まだまだたくさん残っているのだ。
dialogues.en:
There's a lot of curry left for us to finish, not only at
breakfast but also at lunch and dinner.
dialogues.text:
There's a lot of curry left for us to finish, not only at
breakfast but also at lunch and dinner.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、美味いからいいんだけどね……」
dialogues.en: "I don't mind at all because it's so tasty......"
dialogues.text: "I don't mind at all because it's so tasty......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What? ......Did you say something?"
dialogues.text: "What? ......Did you say something?"

dialogues.jp:
カップと大きめの皿を置きながら、頼子さんが
首を傾げる。
dialogues.en:
She cocks her head at me as she puts the plates and cups on
the table.
dialogues.text:
She cocks her head at me as she puts the plates and cups on
the table.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、何も。……ていうか、これ、何？」
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing. ......Anyway, what are these?"
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing. ......Anyway, what are these?"

dialogues.jp:
皿に乗っている物体を指差す。ご飯かと思いき
や、違う。
dialogues.en:
I point at the objects on the plate. I thought they were
rice, but they aren't.
dialogues.text:
I point at the objects on the plate. I thought they were
rice, but they aren't.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、それは、ナンです。焼きたてですよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, they're naan. I just baked them."
dialogues.text: "Oh, they're naan. I just baked them."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「その、ご飯ばっかりじゃ寂しいと思って。お
　嫌いでした？」
dialogues.en:
"I thought you might get tired of eating curry with rice all
the time. ......You don't like naan?"
dialogues.text:
"I thought you might get tired of eating curry with rice all
the time. ......You don't like naan?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、んなことはないけど」
dialogues.en: "No, it's not that."
dialogues.text: "No, it's not that."

dialogues.jp:
つまり、カレーが続くのは、初めから織り込み
済みだったのね。
dialogues.en:
So that means she knew and sort of planned to have curry for
a few meals.
dialogues.text:
So that means she knew and sort of planned to have curry for
a few meals.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: 靴に足を入れ、振り返った。
dialogues.en: I turn around as I put my shoes on.
dialogues.text: I turn around as I put my shoes on.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「俺、頼子さんが好きだ」
dialogues.en: "I love you, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "I love you, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あぅ……な、何ですか、急に……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah...... Why are you saying that now all of a
sudden......?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah...... Why are you saying that now all of a
sudden......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、何か、言いたくなって」
dialogues.en: "I just wanted to."
dialogues.text: "I just wanted to."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「頼子さんは？」
dialogues.en: "What about you?"
dialogues.text: "What about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「わ、私だって……好きですよ……」
dialogues.en: "I... love you, too......"
dialogues.text: "I... love you, too......"

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしげに視線を逸らしながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en: She looks embarrassed and says without looking at me.
dialogues.text: She looks embarrassed and says without looking at me.

dialogues.jp: 「うん。……じゃあ、行ってきます」
dialogues.en: "Okay. ...... I'm off to school now."
dialogues.text: "Okay. ...... I'm off to school now."

dialogues.en: ◆I guess I was sleeping light. Or maybe I was already awake when it happened.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I guess I was sleeping light. Or maybe I was already awake when it happened.◆

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんが起こしに来てくれて、朝食を食べて、
dialogues.en:
I heard the door open, sensed the air move, and felt the
eyes and the heart looking at me.
dialogues.text:
I heard the door open, sensed the air move, and felt the
eyes and the heart looking at me.

dialogues.jp:
ふたり、赤い目をしている事を除けばいつも通
りの朝。
dialogues.en:
She must have come in my room very quietly. But it still
woke me up.
dialogues.text:
She must have come in my room very quietly. But it still
woke me up.

dialogues.jp:
そうして俺は、いつも通り家を後にしたのだっ
た。
dialogues.en: Now Yoriko-san is in my room.
dialogues.text: Now Yoriko-san is in my room.
